content:
Overview

Bonn is a city in North Rhine-Westphalia with a population of 330,000. The former capital on the Rhine, now a UN hub with a charming old town, Beethoven’s birthplace, and a relaxed riverside lifestyle. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
